notes.title: Mad Chess Beta 0.85 - Carbuncles, Kobolds & Mandrakes factions -
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Three new factions enter the madness ! Burrow underground with the Kobolds and emerge to inflict status effects on the enemies, or play with the sun/moon cycle of the Mandrakes to control the center of the board, or use the Carbuncles with their unusual move patterns and first-move bonus to mystify your opponent!
[*]New updated keywords: travel = non-capturing move, capture = capturing move, move = non-capturing or capturing move; meaning a pawn travels forward (1) but captures diagonally (1), and a queen moves surround (7).
[*]Updated all unit ability descriptions to be shorter and integrate the new keywords
[*]Time increments added to versus and multiplayer games (0, 3, 5 or 10 seconds)
[*]Change to chaos mode: now only randomizes units from any factions + adding 3 objects (does not shuffle the pieces in the back rank anymore)
[*]New shuffle mode: click on the shuffle option to shuffle your queen, knights and bishops with any army (also works with random and chaos)
[*]Chessboards: added the sky board, made the marble board the default one and added a random board option for any versus/multiplayer game.
[*]Info menu added to the main screen: simple screen with additional information about the game
[*]Slightly increased AI power: the AI now understands better some abilities (including the goblins curse) and can go up to depth 5-6 (plys) in endgames with fewer units on the board
[*]Balance update to many units (many of these changes are to reflect the exclusive use of each faction's mechanics)
[/list]
[b]
Balance update[/b]:
[list]
[*]Tengu: New ability for the Dojo (if under threat can leap move around the ally king)
[*]Demons: All new rune move patterns for Demons (all of their moves are either normal or leaping instead of travel + moves)
[*]Genies: New ability for Lamp (if on the edges of the board, can move slide along the edges by (1)), new ability for Djinn (can travel on the board as if it was horizontally cylindrical)
[*]Angels: New ability for Throne (becomes invincible on the last rank)
[*]Secret: New ability for Limb (promotes on the 7th or 8th rank), new ability for Queen (promotes to Hand/Amazon when moving to the last rank with 150MP), Brain loses its old 150 MP that promotes all rooks into queens
[*]Tikis: New ability for the Totem (can switch form by travelling forward or backward by (1)) (forms are diagonal (4) or cross-split (1)), Tiki mole is gone and replaced with the Tiki Hog (enemies cannot travel and land on any adjacent square to it)
[*]Yetis: New ability for Tusk (can capture both an enemy and its defending pawn if in the same leap direction), buff to Igloo: the ability works for range 3-4
[*]Mermaids: Small buff to Spine (creates water squares underneath itself even without moving)
[*]Vampires: New ability for Tomb (when capturing an ally ghoul, gains leaping moves for the rest of the game)
[*]Nagas: rework to Empress (it gets its surround (2) aura for the front pawn back, but once it survives one capture, it loses 1 surround range and becomes surround (3)
[*]Aliens: New ability to Scout (moving sideways triggers an instant but optional ally king travel)
[/list]

notes.title: Mad Chess Beta 0.84 - Chaos random faction -
notes.content:
1 big feature added in this patch (for beta testers):

[h2]New Big Feature[/h2]
[list][*]Chaos random faction: Unlock the chaos option in the shop as an alternate random faction: (a) each unit is randomized from any of the 17 factions, (b) the initial positions of the knights, bishops and queen are randomized, (c) 3 terrain objects are randomly spawned in the 2 ranks in front of the chaos army, (d) some additional rules are applied to the secret king, Kraken and Hydra to have enough units to activate their potential.[/list]

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]
[list][*]New terrain object: the Vault (can only be captured by pawn-type units) (the vault will show up in chaos mode)
[*]New in-game ability icons for +15 units (kept the animations for kings, vampires, aliens and goblin queen only).
[*]Dragons are now out of the initial selection for new players in versus mode and added in the shop (since Goblins are unlocked after mission 2 in adventure).[/list]

[h2]Balance Update[/h2]
[list][*]Tengu: buff to the Crow (orthogonal passive leaps), buff to the Dojo (new counter ability with passive knight leaps)
[*]Mermaids: buff to the Shell (creates 4 water squares instead of 3)
[*]Yetis: adventure nerf to Tusk (ability only works up to range 4)
[*]Angels: Nerf to Shield from surround (3) cannot be captured by pawns to surround (4) cannot capture or be captured by pawns
[*]Scarabs: Nerf to Rhino from surround (4) give surround (2) to King to surround (3) give surround (3) to King
[*]Nagas: Nerf to Empress (front pawn gets surround (1) instead of surround (2) )
[*]Aliens: Nerf to Scout (cannot mimic enemy kings anymore)
[*]Goblins: Nerf to queen (surround (3) instead of (4) ), nerf to Rook (orthogonal (3) / surround (3) for king capture instead of orthogonal (4) / surround 4 for king capture)[/list]

[h2]What's coming next[/h2]
[list][*]Additional chess boards
[*]Info menu
[*]Super tough adventure levels 41-50 (with +6 new units)
[*]time increments
[*] another surprise[/list]

Thank you for your support and don't forget to wishlist Mad Chess !

notes.title: Mad Chess Beta 0.83 - Goblins & Arcade mode -
notes.content:
3 big features are added in this patch (for beta testers):

[h2]New Big Features[/h2]
[list][*]Goblins are added to the game as the 17th faction ! (Assassins with special abilities against the enemy king)
[*]Arcade mode added to Adventure (unlock reserve units and create your slightly customizable army to tackle the adventure levels)
[*]Analysis mode added as an option at the end of any game (check all your moves, and even replay levels by retroactively changing your decisions)[/list]

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]
[list][*]Art update: (i) New world map additions, (ii) Gold chest visual for wins/losses, (iii) tengu + goblin on the main screen, (iv) updated faction button colors
[*]New animations for certain units (work in progress, more will be added, and the existing ones will be tweaked)
[*]A few bug fixes; now able to draw arrows during opponent's turn, selected unit can move right after opponent's turn without having to re-click, monkey throw pawn promotion fixed, beta testers not having access to mermaids/dragons/genies fixed (hopefully).[/list]

[h2]What's coming next[/h2]
[list]
[*]Additional chess boards
[*]Chaos "random" faction
[*]Info menu
[*]Super tough adventure levels 41-50 (with +6 new units)
[*]Next batch of nerfs/buffs
[*]other stuff obviously because I can't stop feature creeping[/list]

Thank you for your support and don't forget to wishlist Mad Chess !

notes.title: Mad Chess Beta 0.82 - Wace's Workshop -
notes.content:
Development for the game has been steady and shared primarily on Discord, but now that Mad Chess is getting closer to a real final product, all the next updates will be shared here as well.

[h2]General upgrades[/h2]
[list][*]Workshop: (i) Buy any factions you want without playing adventure mode (ii) buy 8 new boards (with more incoming)  and (iii) buy an adventure reset (*Please note that this shop is only a first iteration and that the prices are low now so that you can buy everything almost instantly but will be increased later to match the real experience for new players)
[*]Cancel premoves: you can now cancel your premoves by clicking the unit or right-clicking
[*]Adventure boards: most levels now have a pre-determined new board (still missing a few) + new dragon/centaur forest on world map to match the background[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that made it impossible to leave a multiplayer game when clicking ''close'' to check the game
[*]Fixed a bug that made the main menu music play during online games
[*]Fixed a bug that made the game generate different factions if someone picked ''random'' while the other player didn't have all factions unlocked
[*]Having only 2 kings on the board is now an automatic draw (more of these rules will follow).[/list]
[h2]What's coming next[/h2]
[list]
[*]Eight new chess boards
[*]Another fun surprise for the Shop yet to be teased (+shop / gold earning polish)
[*]Info menu
[*]Next batch of nerfs/buffs[/list]

Thank you for your support and don't forget to wishlist Mad Chess !
